'''Mallyx's Maul''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]], which spawns after [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] is defeated in [[the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance 10%)
:Health +30
